中国传统"天人合一"，在现代生态学里能怎么理解？

How can the traditional "unity of heaven and human" be understood in modern ecology?

它接近"人与自然是耦合系统"的观点：人的活动改变环境，环境反过来约束人的选择；可持续不是征服自然，而是把自己放进生态循环里统筹。
It resembles the view that nature and people are coupled systems: human acts change the environment, which in turn constrains choices. Sustainability means placing ourselves inside ecological cycles, not conquering them.

传统农林复合系统，为什么比单一农田更"稳"？

Why are traditional agroforestry systems more "stable" than monocultures?

树上果、林下禽、地里粮多层利用，一种受灾还有别的兜底；多样结构像"不把鸡蛋放一个篮子"，抗虫、抗旱、保肥都更稳。
Trees, understory fowl and crops use multiple layers, so one failure leaves others—like not putting eggs in one basket; the diversity steadies pest, drought and fertility shocks.

古人讲"顺天时、量地利"，对应今天什么环保理念？

What modern green idea does "follow the season, read the land" correspond to?

对应"顺应自然、因地制宜"：在合适的时间、合适的土地做合适的事，而不是一刀切地改造；这正和今天的适应性管理、生态农业相通。
It matches "work with nature, fit the place": doing the right thing at the right time and land rather than forcing uniformity—close to today's adaptive management and agroecology.
